# SKP interoperability fixtures

These minimal models are from Kurt Granroth's Skpwright corpus, pinned to commit
`491e1fc7bb8ba135f7e3863d38abda29004c68bf`, the source of Skpwright 0.6.1.
They retain the upstream GPL-3.0-only license. See the repository's
`docs/licenses/skpwright-GPL-3.0.txt`.
